title: Base Write Single Coil variant 4
purpose: Exercise single-coil write handling with a complete canonical request and a matched normal response so parsers traverse both request and confirmation paths.
expected_behavior: A conforming peer would typically echo the single-coil write request fields in a normal response with the same transaction and unit identifiers.
constraints_preserved: 7-byte MBAP header used in both messages
MBAP length 0006 matches unit identifier plus 5-byte PDU
Function code 05 matches the named Write Single Coil operation
Transaction identifier is consistent across request and response
issue_safety_notes: Model-prior conservative seed only. No external protocol validation or issue knowledge was used, and expected behavior is stated cautiously without vulnerability implications.
